notes.title: v1.0.13
notes.content:
[list][*][p]Added warning effect when resetting data[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some background elements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with certain BGM playback[/p][/*][*][p]Changed behavior when skipping the ending[/p][p]Previously, skipping the ending would send you to the result screen
It now transitions to the post-ending instead
This adjustment allows players to reach the post-ending without having to watch the full credits[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect key name display during keyboard input[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where long confirm key names would go off-screen[/p][/*][*][p]Changed soundtrack file format (wav → flac)[/p][/*][/list]
